findings.location: Paragraph beginning “In 1736 John and Charles Wesley sailed to America”
findings.source_quote: “At seven I went to the Germans.”
findings.suggested_fix: Use a form that preserves the printed hour without converting it to Kiswahili clock time, e.g. “Saa 7 niliwaendea Wajerumani.”

findings.location: Poem paragraph beginning “Laiti ningekuwa na ndimi elfu”
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the sense that Christ’s blood was effective or sufficient for the speaker, e.g. “Damu yake ilinipatia wokovu.”
